The '''Amphibious Interstellar Assault Transport/infantry (AIAT/i)''' was a [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Forces]], as well as [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] troops, as a troop [[Transport/Legends|transport]] in the decades before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Jasterslegacy_negvv.png|thumb|left|150px|''[[Jaster's Legacy]]''.]]

The AIAT/i gunship was 31.5 meters long, 12.5 meters high, and had a 30-meter wingspan. It was propelled by a pair of oversized sublight engines, and could carry either 350 cubic meters of cargo or 50 troops, one [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] assault vehicle, four [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]], one [[IM-6 Battlefield Medical Droid/Legends|IM-6 battlefield medical droid]], and six prisoners. It had a number of weapons and was capable of landing on water.

==History==
AIAT/i transports were produced over three decades before the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]]. One of these vessels was used by [[Jaster Mereel]] and known by its military designation, JAST07. Mereel's protege, [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], later used the ship and renamed it ''[[Jaster's Legacy]]''. The ship was destroyed during a job on [[Oovo IV/Legends|Oovo IV]], forcing Fett to steal the [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft/Legends|''Firespray'']] later called [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']] to escape. 

By the time of Fett's ownership, the vessel was described as a "relic" by [[Rozatta]]. 

Jango's [[Cloning/Legends|cloned]] "son" [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] also owned a ship of this class, called ''[[Slave IV]]''.
